senses.gloss: pr. n. pl.Shusht’ré (prob. modern Shuster), in the Babylonian empire (v. Neub. Géogr. p. 382).
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 94a:15">Snh. 94ᵃ</cite> <he>כי מטו לש׳ על חד תרי</he> Ar. (ed. <he>לשוש תרי</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 200) when the Jewish exiles came to Sh., they said, ‘for one (good land) we have found two’; v. <cite ref="U00558"><he>שׁוּשׁ</he></cite>.
